address_quote: Galaxie Covington is located at: 815 Madison Ave Covington, KY 41011

facts.claim: Galaxie’s Covington FAQ describes a wheelchair-accessible entrance, seating and parking. It does not identify the entrance or publish route measurements; contact the location about the arrangements needed.
facts.quote: Galaxie Covington has a wheelchair-accessible entrance, seating, parking, and restroom. Contact the location before visiting if you have a specific accessibility question or need additional assistance.

facts.claim: The Covington FAQ describes a wheelchair-accessible restroom. It does not give the door width, transfer layout, grab-bar arrangement or changing facilities.
facts.quote: Galaxie Covington has a wheelchair-accessible entrance, seating, parking, and restroom.

facts.claim: The venue says it has a dedicated customer parking lot, with street and public parking nearby. It warns that availability can be limited on weekends and during major events; the lot entrance and route to the door are not described.
facts.quote: Galaxie Covington has a dedicated customer parking lot. There is also street parking and public parking options are available in the neighborhood, but availability can be limited during weekends and major events.

facts.claim: A shaded patio has outdoor seating. Availability depends on weather, events and operating conditions; the FAQ does not describe the route or furniture dimensions.
facts.quote: Galaxie Covington has outdoor seating on our shaded patio. Availability may depend on weather, events, and operating conditions.

facts.claim: The venue primarily hosts electronic music, including DJs, house and EDM events. It says the atmosphere can change significantly between weekday food-and-drink service and busy weekend events; no sound levels or quiet-room provision are established.
facts.quote: DJs, electronic music, and dancing are a central part of Galaxie’s Friday, Saturday, and special-event programming. The atmosphere can change significantly between weekday food-and-drink service and a busy weekend event.

facts.claim: The restaurant is primarily walk-in and does not accept standard table reservations. Ticketed events and special programs may have separate entry requirements.
facts.quote: Galaxie Covington is primarily a walk-in establishment and does not accept standard table reservations. Some ticketed events or special programs may have separate admission or entry requirements.

facts.claim: Standard food-and-drink service at the front bar has no cover charge. Ticketed shows and some special events may require advance tickets or payment at the door; check the specific event.
facts.quote: Standard food-and-drink service at the front bar does not require a cover. Admission policies vary by event and night. Ticketed shows and certain special events may require advance purchase or payment at the door.

facts.claim: Guests under 21 are welcomed before 10 p.m., but ticketed shows, late-night programs and special events may have different age rules. Check the specific event before visiting with anyone under 21.
facts.quote: Guests under 21 are welcome at Galaxie Covington before 10:00 p.m. Age restrictions may vary for ticketed shows, late-night programming, and special events.

facts.claim: The menu includes vegetarian and vegan dishes. Guests with allergies or strict dietary requirements are asked to speak to the team before ordering; the kitchen is not represented as completely allergen-free.
facts.quote: The menu includes vegetarian and vegan dishes, along with options that may work for some gluten-free guests. Guests with allergies or strict dietary requirements should speak with the team before ordering, because the kitchen is not represented as completely allergen-free.

facts.claim: Online food ordering is offered for pickup and delivery during applicable kitchen hours. This does not establish curbside handoff or loading assistance.
facts.quote: Online ordering is available for pickup and delivery during applicable kitchen hours.

facts.claim: The Cincinnati FAQ says over 50% of the game rooms are built to be wheelchair accessible. Ask which rooms and activities match the features needed before booking; this percentage is the operator’s statement, not an independent assessment.
facts.quote: Over 50% of our game rooms are built to be wheelchair accessible.

facts.claim: Teams have two to four players, and larger groups are split into smaller teams. The FAQ says guests will not be placed with people they do not know.
facts.quote: A team is comprised of 2-4 people. If you come with a larger group no problem, we can divide you into smaller teams. We will never put you with someone you don’t know.

facts.claim: At check-in, players receive RFID wristbands and start a room by tapping in when its light is green. Individual games take three to five minutes and can be replayed.
facts.quote: Put your team of 2-4 people together, pick an awesome team name, get your RFID wristbands at check in, and you can get started by tapping into any room with a green light. How long does each game take? How long can I play? Each game takes 3-5 minutes. But you can replay each room as often as you like to try to collect the maximum points.

facts.claim: The chosen two- or three-hour reservation covers access to the challenge rooms. The venue allows guests to eat or drink before or after that slot; food and drink stay in the restaurant and lounge, outside the game rooms.
facts.quote: The 2 or 3 hour time slot you have chosen is the amount of time you have access to our challenge rooms. You are welcome to arrive prior to or stay after your reservation time to enjoy food and/or drinks if you do not want this to impede on the time you have access to the challenge rooms.

facts.claim: The venue recommends comfortable athletic clothing and closed-toe shoes, and warns that many challenge rooms are physically demanding. It does not publish a room-by-room demand or transfer guide.
facts.quote: We recommend you wear comfortable athletic clothing and closed-toe shoes. Many of our challenge rooms are physically demanding, so you’ll want to leave the high heels at home.

facts.claim: Advance online booking is recommended for the preferred time, particularly on weekends and holidays; walk-ins are accepted when space permits. Every player needs a waiver, with a parent or guardian completing it for players under 18.
facts.quote: We suggest you book online to guarantee your preferred time, and to save time at check in. We often sell out, especially on weekends and holidays, but we always accept walks-ins when we can. Do I need to fill out a waiver? A waiver is required for all Players. Fill one out ahead of time when you book your tickets to save time at check in. All Players under the age of 18 must have a parent or guardian fill out a waiver in order for them to participate.

facts.claim: The FAQ allows a 15-minute arrival delay; after that, the reservation may be given to a waiting-list guest or walk-in.
facts.quote: If you arrive within 15 minutes of your reserved time, we will honor your reservation. After 15 minutes your spot may be given to individuals on the waiting list or walk-ins.

facts.claim: Ticket cancellations at least 12 hours ahead receive a full refund; less notice receives credit for a future visit. Once play has begun, the FAQ says full and partial refunds are unavailable. Separate event-booking rules apply.
facts.quote: Ticket cancellation made at least 12 hours in advance will receive a full refund. Ticket cancellations made with less than 12 hours notice will receive a credit that can be used toward a future BRKTHROUGH visit. Once you have arrived and begin play, BRKTHROUGH does not offer full or partial refunds.

facts.claim: Free lockers are available. The FAQ does not describe their size, height, reach or locking controls.
facts.quote: We have free lockers on site for your belongings.

facts.claim: Children ten and under need an adult playing the rooms with them. Ages 11–14 need an attentive adult remaining in the building; ages 15–17 may play without an adult on site once a parent or guardian completes the waiver.
facts.quote: Children ages 10 and under must be accompanied by an adult who plays the rooms with them. Guests ages 11–14 must have an adult remain in the building and be attentive at all times. Guests ages 15–17 may play without an adult on-site once a parent or legal guardian has completed their waiver.

facts.claim: TANK’s Tap & Save page lists fixed-route fare caps of $4 per day and $70 per month when paying through an EZfare account. Once the cap is reached, further rides in that period are free. Confirm the applicable fare and travel period with TANK; the published cap does not resolve the separate reduced-fare source conflict.
facts.quote: Pay as you go: Load money onto your EZfare account and tap to board. No need to buy day or monthly passes in advance. Daily and monthly fare capping: Fixed Routes cap at $4.00/day or $70.00/month Once you reach the cap, additional rides are free for the rest of that period.

facts.claim: To use Tap & Save in the Transit app, create an EZfare account in the app settings, load funds to the wallet and present its QR code to the onboard validator.
